issue.title: How to cross-compile dronecodesdk to run on armv9?
issue.body:
Anyone could help? 
Thanks very much!

@JonasVautherin Good idea! I try it now.

I got this:
cc1plus: error: unrecognized command line option "-std=c++11"
cc1plus: error: unrecognized command line option "-std=c++11"
maybe I should change a cross-compile tool.
This looks like C++11 is not supported. Any chance you can use a more recent compiler?

BTW, do you know [crosstool-ng](https://crosstool-ng.github.io/docs/) and/or [dockcross](https://github.com/dockcross/dockcross)? Dockcross doesn't seem to have armv9 (yet), but it may be worth asking them what it would require.
